The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. We need to determine how many gallons to add to reach full capacity. But we don't know current fuel in gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 10 liters = 10 / 3.78541 = ~2.642 gallons. So tank capacity 50 gallons, current ~2.642 gallons, need to add 47.358 gallons. But maybe the tank capacity is 50 gallons, but we might want to fill to 50 gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = 50 - current gallons. But we need to get current fuel in gallons. We only have fuel level in liters. We can convert. Use gallon_to_liter or liter_to_gallon. There's a function gallon_to_liter and liter_to_gallon. We can use liter_to_gallon to convert 10 liters to gallons. Then compute needed. Let's do that.
